decisions.reason: The premium raisin stollen sits squarely within the firm's confectionery know-how and has won the German Bread Institute gold medal again, so the firm can read clear positive feedback and keep refining it.

The dark barley malt rye bread builds on established bread-making knowledge and has survived on its own page into 2024 while sister breads were dropped, which suggests the firm judged it a viable addition despite little external evidence.
The marzipan stollen is a close extension of the firm's seasonal stollen expertise, is still featured on its own page, and benefits from the reputation of the award-winning stollen line.
